meanings: 【形容詞】(細身の、スリムな) thin and of a pleasing shape; having a graceful slender figure
【形容詞】(わずかな、小さな) small in size or likelihood; a slim chance of success
【動詞】(スリムにする、細くする) to make or become slim or thinner; to reduce in size
